newsitem.title: USA: Embrex Inc Q1 net income slightly higher.
newsitem.headline: Embrex Inc Q1 net income slightly higher.

text.p: (Dollars in thousands except per share amounts)
*Refer to footnote on Statement of Operations
NOTE: Gross margin improved from 48.3 percent during the 1996 first quarter to 54.8 percent currently.

Operating expenses and taxes for the quarter were $819,000 higher than the same period last year, primarily due to the combined cost of foreign expansion, legal fees related to patent infringement matters and general corporate and research and development activity.

At March 31, 1997, cash and short-term investments totaling $9.9 million were basically unchanged from the amount on hand at December 31, 1996, reflecting the ability of Embrex to fund its capital needs out of operating cash flows.

In addition, Embrex believes it will be able to use its existing cash in conjunction with cash flow generated by operations to fund its capital needs and continued international expansion during the balance of 1997.

Certain 1996 operating expenses were reclassified to cost of revenues to conform to the presentation format adopted in the fourth quarter of 1996. These reclassifications had no effect on previously reported financial results.
